title: Hearing on gender-affirming care for transgender youth
summary: The Council's Committees on Mental Health & Substance Use, Hospitals, and Women and Gender Equity held an oversight hearing on access to gender-affirming care and its mental health effects for transgender and nonbinary youth. The hearing also covered a bill requiring the Health Department to post LGBTQI+ health resources and a searchable map of services, and two resolutions urging Albany to expand gender-affirming care access and require anti-bias training for medical students. Officials noted federal actions restricting such care and reported the Council allocated $3.5 million in fiscal 2027 for related youth health services.
